Cool upstairs seating with nice green view
Aug 2026 • Family

Good food but having to fetch your own bike in the heat was exhausting
Aug 2026 • Friends
Met up with a few friends for lunch. Ordered 3 dishes coming out to 500k flat and we were completely stuffed. That Tom Yum noodle dish was so spicy and satisfying. But man, the parking setup is just bizarre. The sun was scorching yet they left customer bikes out in the open without any cover. The guard was totally indifferent, didn't even bother pulling the bike out and made us cross the road just to pay via QR. The owner needs to fix this ASAP or they'll lose customers for sure

Convenient for meeting partners, fast service
Aug 2026 • Business
Popped in for a quick lunch during my business trip to Hanoi. The place was fairly crowded, but the kitchen served the food surprisingly fast, so my schedule wasn't delayed. The beef was tender, salad fresh. Tables are spaced out well enough to have a private conversation without feeling overheard. Around 250k per person is very reasonable for a central location. Will consider coming back on my next trip.

Very good for families with small children.
Aug 2026 • Family
Last weekend I took two kids here for lunch and had a pretty pleasant experience. Just entering the restaurant, the staff noticed there was a small child so actively bring the baby chair out immediately, I found very attentive. My two kids especially liked crisp Nachos, keep scoring their fever and eating it all the time. The space is clean, the machine is cool, the food is not smelly. The price is reasonable compared to the quality of goods and services. I’m sure the whole house will come back next time.

Food actually matches Southern taste so well
Jul 2026 • Friends
The two of us came out from Saigon to visit Hanoi right around the recent storm, weather was pretty muggy so we popped in to try. Gotta admit the Tom Yum noodles are legit good, rich flavor with a real spicy kick. Staff speak with such a sweet Northern accent and take super good care of customers. Good food but the parking guy was super annoying
Jul 2026 • Friends
Just went here for lunch with a few coworkers today. Stepping out in 39°C heat almost made me pass out, so getting inside with the AC was a total relief. The Tom Yum noodles were so addictive, just the right amount of kick, and the burrata salad was super fresh. Everything was going smoothly until it was time to get our bikes. The security guard just stood there and didn't bother helping us drag the bike out at all, then made us walk across the street in the scorching sun just to scan a QR code. The bike seat was literally burning hot from sitting in the sun. Great food, but this kind of parking service really ruined the mood.
